posts.hook: The AI buildout just hit a credit wall
posts.caption: musk says spacex closed $40b of gpu debt while credit shuts for most ai data center firms, openai and anthropic cut llm prices by up to 80%, and anthropic is sued over elvis songs. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: SpaceX closes ==$40B== of GPU debt as credit shuts for other AI data center firms
slides.desc: Musk says 200+ neoclouds face death and consolidation.

terms.gloss: newer companies that rent out GPU computing power

slides.title: Data center tenants now demand $5M+ a day in late-delivery fees
slides.desc: Up from $1M this spring, and brokers now sell delay insurance.

slides.title: OpenAI and Anthropic cut LLM prices by up to ==80%== within months
slides.desc: List prices are falling fast, so discounts alone are no moat.

slides.title: Anthropic is sued for allegedly using 274 Elvis Presley songs to train AI
slides.desc: The claims are allegations; it opens a music front in training-data fights.

slides.title: Brotli2Shell: another shared-decoder bug, this time beyond Node and HTTP
slides.desc: Shared decompression code keeps turning into attack surface.

terms.gloss: a compression format browsers and servers use to shrink web traffic
